title: Add onboarding checklist docs entry + linkouts to SDK production readiness guides
author: Wei Chen
description: Summary: Adds a new canonical docs entry for the Guided Onboarding / First Production Launch checklist and wires it into the docs nav + search. This page is intended to be the “source of truth” content that the Console checklist deep-links to (step-specific sections and anchors), while also serving self-serve users who hit docs first. The page includes: (1) a short explanation of what the checklist is and who it’s for, (2) a step-by-step “recommended order” (API key → first request → streaming → retries/timeouts → usage/quotas/budgets → model pinning + fallback → observability hooks), and (3) explicit linkouts to SDK-specific production readiness guides for Python/TypeScript/Go. Motivation: We’re seeing repeated onboarding support tickets around 401/403, streaming disconnect expectations, and 429 surprises. The Console feature (PM-742 / ENG-5814) needs stable URLs/anchors to deep link from each step. This PR creates that canonical docs surface and aligns copy/tone to DES-427. What’s included: - New docs page: “Onboarding checklist (first production launch)” with stable anchors per step (e.g., #create-an-api-key, #first-successful-request, #streaming-in-production, #retries-and-timeouts, #quotas-and-budgets, #pin-a-model-version, #fallback-policy, #observability). - Adds “Onboarding checklist” to the Getting Started section in the sidebar and adds it to the docs landing “Recommended next steps” list. - Adds a short “SDK production readiness” panel linking to the SDK guides (Python/TS/Go). - Adds a small note clarifying that usage dashboard can lag by a few minutes, and points to the canonical explanation page (keeps the detailed troubleshooting in existing docs). - Adds redirect stub from an older internal draft URL used during dogfood. Out of scope / follow-ups: - Step-by-step guided tour content (in-product) is handled in Console; this page stays intentionally lightweight and link-forward. - Quotas/budgets how-to content will be expanded in a separate PR once the Terraform snippet PR lands (redwood-terraform/pr-233). - Dedicated/Private variants of the checklist: we keep Hosted API framing here; we can add Dedicated/Private tabs later once their steps stabilize. Verification: - Built locally with docs site build (yarn build) and link checker. - Manually validated that anchors are stable and match the deep-link pattern requested in the Console UX spec (no auto-generated heading IDs that might churn). - Confirmed copy constraints and section names with Design (DES-427) for consistency with Console step names. Screenshots: Attached in PR (sidebar placement + page top + SDK panel).

review_conversation: Elliot Price (Docs lead): Can we keep this page ‘link-forward’ and avoid duplicating all the how-to content? Also, please ensure anchor IDs are explicit so Console deep links don’t break when headings change.
Wei Chen (author): Yep—kept each step to 3–6 bullets and pushed details into existing how-tos. Updated headings to use explicit IDs (no auto slug).
Tessa Morgan (Design): Step names should match Console copy: “First successful request” vs “Make your first request”. Also please keep warnings short; we don’t want a wall of text at the top.
Wei Chen (author): Updated step headings to match DES-427 language and moved warnings into a small ‘Common pitfalls’ callout lower on the page.

Monica Patel (SDK lead): The SDK links should point to the production readiness guides (timeouts/retries/streaming reconnect) not the generic quickstarts. Also, include a note about idempotency for retryable requests where applicable.
Wei Chen (author): Updated linkouts to production readiness guides and added a short bullet under retries/timeouts about idempotency keys + safe retry semantics (kept non-SDK-specific).

Jean-Paul Laurent (Onboarding content): Suggest adding a one-liner on what ‘first production launch’ means (e.g., non-trivial traffic / real users) so people don’t assume ‘first curl’ is production-ready.
Wei Chen (author): Added a definition line + clarified that the checklist is recommended before routing end-user traffic, but you can complete early steps immediately after signup.
Elliot Price (final): Approved. Please add redirect from the dogfood draft URL and we’re good.
Wei Chen (author): Added redirect in config/redirects.json and re-ran link check.
